explanation: A baseline rebuilds changed-level drone entries in combat_weapon_entries; its long_laser_valid requires entry object identity and pending repeats require identity too. Endpoints show 16 retained ordinary primary/repeat beams, five replaced drone primary beams, and no drone repeats. Its 40 sample startups equal five drones times eight upgrade batches. B preserves numeric-upgrade snapshots and all 26 primary/repeat beams; this is the approved contract, not less combat work. A remaining 40 periods and 440 chain hits close the aggregate accounting; no per-step trajectory replay was collected.

period_delta.note: The retained ordinary beams have endpoint tick deltas 69 in A versus 70 in B. This is an observed boundary-phase difference; no claim attributes it to an individual startup time or changes the configured interval.

rng: Different by design because A executes additional startup/repeat decisions after upgrades. Not asserted equal.
visual_review: Both saved PNGs show full equipment UI, all 15 enemies and active beam/chain presentation; B also shows sustained drone beams. No display reduction.
known_limitation: Existing wave-end atomic handoff resumes the old Game; no cross-wave native re-admission change. Earlier accepted death/travel/retarget checks reused.
